The Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Mail Operations will serve as a technical and operational expert supporting email operations, spam/abuse mitigation, and Trust & Safety workflows. The role will be responsible for handling complex and escalated cases, providing subject matter guidance to analysts, monitoring emerging email abuse trends, and supporting operational excellence in a 24x7 environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the Subject Matter Expert for email operations, spam, phishing, spoofing, abuse, and related Trust & Safety workflows.
  • Provide real-time guidance and support to analysts in handling complex, high-risk, and escalated email abuse cases.
  • Review complex cases and ensure decisions are aligned with defined policies, procedures, and security protocols.
  • Monitor trends related to spam, phishing, spoofing, malware, account abuse, and other forms of email-based threats, and identify emerging patterns.
  • Support incident investigations, root cause analysis (RCA), and corrective/preventive actions for operational and quality issues.
  • Conduct regular knowledge-sharing, coaching, calibration, and refresher sessions for analysts to improve process understanding and decision accuracy.
  • Support Team Leaders and Operations Managers with quality, productivity, SLA, and operational performance insights.
  • Leverage Splunk and other relevant tools to monitor operational trends, investigate incidents, track KPIs, and generate actionable insights.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, SMTP, email headers, and email infrastructure to support investigations and troubleshooting.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend process improvements, automation opportunities, and workflow optimizations.
  • Support the development and maintenance of SOPs, process documentation, knowledge articles, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Participate in calibration sessions and quality reviews to drive consistency and accuracy across the team.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including Trust & Safety, Security, Engineering, Product, Quality, and Operations, to resolve complex issues and improve workflows.
  • Support new-hire training, nesting, upskilling, and ongoing capability-building for the operations team.
  • Stay current on evolving email threats, abuse patterns, authentication standards, and industry best practices, and translate relevant insights into operational improvements.

Qualifications:

  • Strong understanding of SMTP, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, email headers, DNS, and email infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk, including dashboard usage, log analysis, monitoring, and investigation.
  • Strong knowledge of spam, phishing, spoofing, malicious emails, email abuse, and threat vectors.
  • Demonstrated experience handling complex investigations, escalations, and incident analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify patterns and determine appropriate actions.
  • Experience conducting RCA, trend analysis, quality reviews, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and provide real-time operational guidance in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience working in a 24x7 operational setup is preferred.

  • Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in email security, cybersecurity, Trust & Safety, or abuse prevention.
  • Knowledge of SIEM tools, threat intelligence, log analysis, and security monitoring.
  • Familiarity with automation, scripting, or data-analysis tools.
  • Experience working with large-scale email platforms or cloud-based email environments.

job.title: Lead -Quality Assurance (Email Abuse)
job.description:
Company Description:

At Sutherland we are a group of energetic and driven individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Job Description:

Role Summary

A Quality Analyst – Email Abuse within the Trust & Safety team will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and effectiveness of decisions made while identifying and addressing abusive, fraudulent, and malicious email activity.

The role involves conducting regular audits, identifying quality and policy gaps, supporting calibration sessions, performing root cause analysis, and providing actionable feedback to Operations and Training teams.

The Quality Analyst will work across email abuse scenarios such as spam, phishing, scams, malicious content, impersonation, spoofing, account compromise, and other forms of email-based abuse, ensuring decisions are aligned with client policies, SOPs, and applicable Trust & Safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audit Planning & Execution

  • Conduct Daily/Weekly/Monthly quality audits of Email Abuse cases based on defined sampling guidelines.
  • Ensure adequate coverage across different case types, risk levels, workflows, and escalation categories.
  • Perform audits on agent decisions to assess accuracy, policy adherence, investigation quality, and appropriate enforcement actions.
  • Conduct Live, Recorded, and Side-by-Side evaluations as required.
  • Ensure audit completion within defined QA SLAs.
  • Identify critical errors and immediately escalate high-risk or policy-sensitive cases.

2. Quality Assurance & Monitoring

  • Maintain adherence to defined sampling, audit, and agent-feedback SLAs.
  • Evaluate cases for correct identification and classification of email abuse.
  • Assess the accuracy of decisions involving:
    • Spam and unsolicited email
    • Phishing
    • Scams and fraudulent communications
    • Malicious or suspicious links
    • Impersonation and spoofing
    • Account compromise
    • Malicious attachments or content
    • Abuse of email services
  • Identify trends in quality defects, policy misses, investigation errors, and incorrect enforcement decisions.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring or high-impact quality issues.
  • Recommend corrective action plans and targeted coaching for repeated performance gaps.
  • Track improvement following corrective actions.

3. Calibration & Consistency Management

  • Participate in regular calibration sessions with QA, Training, Operations, and SME teams.
  • Ensure consistent interpretation and application of Email Abuse policies.
  • Participate in client and cross-location calibration sessions where applicable.
  • Identify policy ambiguity and gray-area cases requiring clarification.
  • Document calibration outcomes and communicate changes to relevant stakeholders.
  • Support Gage R&R / Repeatability & Reproducibility exercises, where applicable, to assess consistency and reliability of quality evaluations.

4. Risk Mitigation & Compliance Management

  • Identify and escalate critical Email Abuse violations and high-risk cases.
  • Monitor for systemic failures that may result in increased exposure to phishing, scams, fraud, malicious activity, or platform abuse.
  • Partner with Trust & Safety Policy, Training, and Operations teams to identify gaps in SOP and policy interpretation.
  • Ensure appropriate escalation of cases requiring SME, Policy, or client review.
  • Support compliance with data privacy, information security, and client-specific requirements.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation and risk logs for critical quality issues.

5. Reporting & Stakeholder Management

  • Prepare and maintain regular QA reports covering:
    • Quality scores
    • Error trends
    • Policy adherence
    • Critical errors
    • Sampling coverage
    • Audit completion
    • RCA findings
    • Corrective actions
  • Translate quality findings into actionable recommendations for Training, Operations, and Policy teams.
  • Share recurring quality gaps and recommend refresher or targeted training.
  • Present quality trends and improvement opportunities during team reviews and governance meetings.
  • Work closely with Training and Operations to monitor the effectiveness of corrective actions.
  • Support WBRs, QBRs, client governance reviews, and other quality forums as required.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in any stream.
  • 1.5–3 years of experience in Quality Assurance, preferably within Trust & Safety, Email Abuse, Fraud Operations, Risk Operations, Content Moderation, or Policy Enforcement.
  • Experience conducting transaction/case-level audits and providing structured feedback.
  • Strong understanding of quality metrics, sampling, audit methodology, and RCA.
  • Ability to interpret and apply policy consistently across complex and ambiguous cases.
  • Good understanding of Email Abuse concepts such as spam, phishing, scams, spoofing, impersonation, malicious links, and account compromise.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Operations, Training, Policy, and SME teams.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint is preferred.

job.title: Project Manager - Software Solutions Implementation
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 38 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Sutherland is looking for Project Managers who want to benefit from a great Onboarding program, work environment, job stability and professional growth opportunities working with multicultural teams all over the globe for one of the biggest IT Solutions multinationals in the world. The Project Manager is responsible of planning and controlling the diverse activities required to deliver projects to final customers on time, on budget, and with the required quality, despite risks and issues. Lead activities to foresee risks and issues and create the required mitigation plans. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Main Responsibilities and Deliverables Strengthen relationships:

  • End-to-end management of a project or program of projects including:
  • Scope Management
  • Time Management
  • Cost Management (budgeting, forecasting, revenue, etc.)
  • Quality Management
  • Human Resource/ Personnel Management
  • Communications Management
  • Risk Management
  • Stakeholder (internal and external) Management
  • Manage all phases of project – Initiation, Planning, Execution, Monitor and Control and Closing
  • Effective use of project management methodology, processes, tools, techniques and templates. In doing so, define project tasks and prepare project plans. Monitor, manage, and communicate project progress.
  • Manage project scope and scope changes. Manage & motivate the team assigned to the project. Provide feedback regarding their performances.
  • Being the single point of contact for assigned projects and customer representation or Business Unit in internal and external /customer forums by providing effective communication.
  • Act as a trusted adviser for assigned clients and assist with the development of roadmaps and other long range plans for leveraging the solution and maximizing the ROI.
  • Manage issues proactively, provide visibility of issues and resolution to stakeholders and escalate internally as required to resolve issues
  • Report on Status of project to internal and external stakeholders accurately on agreed frequency
  • Manage project related revenue and revenue forecast. Keep management systems updated to reflect revenue forecasting.
  • Measure the quality and efficiency of each delivery. Proactively provide feedback on lessons learned and suggestions for future improvements. Contribute to project management methodology improvements. Provide assessment of project results.
  • Be part of the broader PM community to participate, contribute, learn and collaborate to increase efficiency of Project Management at the company.

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have:

  • Minimum of 5 Years of current proven experience as a PM leading teams and manage people in a matrix environment. Experience with international clients is required.
  • Experience working as a project manager for a consulting or software organization or similar delivering solutions to external clients.
  • Experience managing the full software SDLC as a project manager, including discovery, design and development of custom solutions
  • Proven Ability to manage complex and dynamic projects for external customers.
  • Proven Ability to manage large and simultaneity projects.
  • Proven experience managing IT and Software delivery projects.
  • Proven Ability to form strong customer relationships.
  • Proven Ability to span business and technical issues.
  • Ability and willingness to work in a highly dynamic environment.
  • Ability to work in a global collaborative team environment.
  • Strong business acumen and orientation.
  • Revenue forecast management.
  • Budget management.
  • PMP Certification desirable
  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in systems engineering and related fields.
  • Proficient communication skills in English.

Additional Information:

This is a Hybrid model position in Bogotá Sutherland's Facilities at Torre Krystal (Cra 7 #156-10, Usaquén)

About Sutherland:

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Design: Design event-driven, cloud-native microservices using design patterns like Saga, Circuit Breaker, CQRS, and Strangler patterns.
  • System Boundaries: Define bounded contexts and single-responsibility services aligned with specific business domains. 
  • Inter-Service Communication: Design and enforce API-first contracts using REST, gRPC, or GraphQL.
  • Data Management: Implement decentralized data management where each service manages its own datastore (NoSQL/RDBMS). 
  • Resilience & Reliability: Design for failure by implementing retries, timeouts, bulkheads, and distributed tracing. 
  • Infrastructure & DevOps: Drive containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines to allow automated deployments.
  • Observability: Ensure comprehensive logging, monitoring, and tracing are integrated across all services using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry

Qualifications:

Essential Qualifications & Tech Stack

  • Experience: Typically 8+ years in software engineering with a minimum of 3-5 years focusing purely on distributed systems and microservices.
  • Programming Languages: Deep expertise in backend ecosystems such as Java/Spring Boot, Go (Golang), Python, or Node.js.
  • Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure.
  • Message Brokers: Familiarity with event streaming and message queues (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS).
  • Security & Governance: Knowledge of zero-trust architectures, OAuth 2.0, SAML, and API Gateways.
  • Soft Skills: Strong technical leadership, excellent documentation abilities, and cross-team communication to evangelize microservices best practices.

  • Quality Leadership:
    • Develop, implement, and maintain quality management systems, policies, and procedures aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.

  • Process Improvement:

    • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for quality and process efficiency.

Job Description:

Technical Support Engineer

Enterprise Storage Platforms

Location:  Bangalore     |     Work Model:  Work from Office     |     Shift:  24x7 Rotational

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join our enterprise storage support team in a high-touch, mission-critical environment. This role is a great fit for someone with solid hands-on experience in enterprise storage and infrastructure troubleshooting who genuinely enjoys solving complex customer problems.

You will work on real-world issues across storage platforms and associated infrastructure, supporting customers through phone, email, chat, and remote sessions. You'll be expected to own cases end to end, communicate clearly under pressure, and bring structured thinking to every troubleshooting scenario.

What You'll Do

  • Provide technical support to enterprise customers on complex storage and infrastructure issues across a global 24x7 model.
  • Own cases end to end, from initial triage through troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and resolution.
  • Diagnose problems spanning storage protocols, host connectivity, controller behaviour, performance symptoms, platform interoperability, and more.
  • Troubleshoot any HW and SW issues that comes up during ongoing platform use.
  • Manage customer communication with professionalism and urgency, especially during business-impacting situations.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including escalation teams, engineering, and customer stakeholders to drive timely outcomes.
  • Maintain high-quality case notes, action plans, and technical documentation throughout the support lifecycle.
  • Adhere to SLA targets, escalation protocols, and quality standards consistently.

 

Required Experience

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience in technical support, infrastructure support, and enterprise storage support.
  • Solid track record in customer-facing troubleshooting roles within enterprise IT environments.
  • Demonstrated hands-on understanding of enterprise storage concepts and troubleshooting methodology.

 

Technical Skills

  • Storage: Strong working knowledge of SAN and NAS environments (protocols - FC, iSCSI, NFS, and CIFS/SMB), including RAID, high availability, controller architecture, disk behaviour, and failover concepts.
  • OS: Good working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration fundamentals.
  • Virtualization: Familiarity with VMware or similar virtualization platforms and their integration with storage.
  • Networking: Good grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Diagnostics: Ability to analyze logs, alerts, symptoms, and customer-reported behaviour to isolate the root cause or likely fault domain.

 

Preferred Skills

  • Experience supporting enterprise storage platforms such as NetApp ONTAP, FAS / AFF controllers, StorageGRID, E-Series, or equivalent (Dell EMC, HPE, Pure, IBM, Hitachi).
  • Prior experience in managed service or enterprise support environments handling platform or infrastructure incidents.
  • Familiarity with critical case management, and ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or equivalent).

 

How You Work

  • You communicate clearly, written and verbal and can hold your own during high-pressure customer conversations.
  • You set expectations well and follow through, even when resolution timelines are uncertain.
  • You stay composed during escalations and apply structured thinking rather than guesswork.
  • You take ownership seriously and don't pass problems without context.
  • You work well with distributed, cross-functional teams across time zones.

 

Qualifications:

Education

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: Kundenservice- & Vertriebsspezialist (m/w/d) – Deutschsprachig
job.description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung:

 Über uns

Wir sind Sutherland, ein global führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Customer Experience Management (CXM) – mit über 37 Jahren Erfolgsgeschichte, mehr als 60 Standorten weltweit und seit 2017 auch im Herzen von Pristina vertreten.
Hier arbeiten über 500 Kolleginnen und Kollegen täglich daran, Service- und Verkaufserlebnisse auf höchstem Niveau zu schaffen – für renommierte Marken und Marktführer in Europa.

Unser Telekommunikationsprojekt für die Premium-Marke Europas ist eines der größten und erfolgreichsten in der Region.
Wir kombinieren exzellenten Kundenservice, moderne Technologien und verkaufsorientierte Beratung – alles mit dem Ziel, unseren Kunden das beste Erlebnis zu bieten.

Stellenbeschreibung:

 DEINE ROLLE

⟢ Als Kundenservice- & Vertriebsspezialist bist du die Stimme der bekanntesten Telekommunikationsmarke Europas.
⟢ Du hilfst Kunden nicht nur bei Fragen zu Internet, Telefonie und TV, sondern nutzt jede Gelegenheit, um bedarfsgerecht zu beraten und mit deinem Engagement Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Konkret heißt das:

⟢ Du bearbeitest Anfragen rund um Produkte und Dienstleistungen eines führenden Telekommunikationsanbieters

⟢ Du löst technische oder administrative Anliegen zuverlässig und freundlich

⟢ Du erkennst Verkaufschancen und präsentierst passende Angebote & Zusatzangebote

⟢ Du trägst aktiv zur Kundenzufriedenheit und zum Teamerfolg bei

Qualifikationen:

WAS DU MITBRINGST

✓ Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1)

✓ Freude am Kundenkontakt und am gemeinsamen Erfolg

✓ Eine kommunikative, lösungsorientierte und positive Art

✓ Motivation, dich weiterzuentwickeln und Herausforderungen anzunehmen

✓ Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Kundenservice ist ein Plus – aber keine Pflicht

Zusätzliche Informationen:

 WARUM SUTHERLAND?

🔗 Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem internationalen Unternehmen

🔗 Leistungsorientierte Vergütung & attraktive Bonusmöglichkeiten

🔗 Moderne Büroräume im Zentrum von Pristina

🔗 Teamspirit & offene Kultur – hier zählt dein Beitrag wirklich

🔗 Coaching & Weiterentwicklung durch erfahrene Führungskräfte zertifizierte Coachs aus dem Ausland

🔗 Erfolgs- und Bonusaktionen, Wettbewerbe & Anerkennung für Leistung

 

💬 KLINGT NACH DIR?

Dann warte nicht – gestalte deine Zukunft mit uns und werde Teil unserer Welt!
Bewirb dich jetzt und starte deine Karriere im Kundenservice & Vertrieb beim Telekomunikationsgiganten in Pristina.

job.title: AWS Network Engineer - Palo Alto firewalls
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 38 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

The purpose of this position is to provide technical assistance to the NICE Cloud Networking Team, coordinating and participating in the design, deployment, operation and maintenance of NICE’s customer cloud hosted network and security infrastructure, while also resolving customer issues that require direct access to the network and security infrastructure, and acting in an appropriate professional working style

The Specialist Cloud Network Engineer has the following duties:

  1. Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain cooperative working relationships within a global, diverse, multicultural environment.
  2. Ability to work with data center or On premise environment, standing for extended periods of time while performing maintenance duties.
  3. Position may be required to work at a computer terminal and desk for long periods of time on projects.
  4. Network and security administration tasks using industry-standard network equipment and software.
  5. Experience operating and maintaining network devices and security products like Palo Alto, Cisco, F5, and other industry-leading network hardware and software.
  6. Experience deploying and supporting IP networks and associated network technologies.
  7. Establishing, configuring & troubleshooting VPN tunnel related works.
  8. Deep understanding on IPSEC protocol, the TCP/IP stack, how a layer 7 FW processes packets. SSL protocol
  9. Ability to write Terraform scripts and good knowledge in GIT is a plus.
  10. Design and testing of network and security infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPN, WAN and other support systems.
  11. Familiarity with Internet and WAN communications technologies, protocols, and best practices.
  12. Minimum 3 Year of Experience with AWS Cloud & managing AWS network stacks is a mandatory.
  13. Minimum 3 Year of Experience with Palo Alto is mandatory.
  14. AWS and Palo Alto Certification is mandatory.
  15. Configuring & troubleshooting URL related works.

Qualifications:

  1. Advanced English proficiency (B2 or Higher)
  2. A minimum of 3 Years of experience in managing Network & Security Infrastructure and administration of associated software and tools.
  3. Demonstrated ability to work with different security appliances like Palo Alto, Cisco firewalls for ACL, NAT, VPN and other technical assistance.
  4. Demonstrated ability to resolve complex technical issues. Encouraging free and open exchange of technical ideas and suggestions and working with regional and global management to implement approved projects.
  5. Demonstrated ability to install and deploy network routers, firewalls, switches, and other support systems as needed to support corporate and hosted capacity, performance, security, or product functionality requirements.
  6. Experience implementing and supporting a production multi-tenant architecture
  7. Demonstrated ability to prepare, review, test, and deploy network configuration and security software to perform administrative tasks as assigned.
  8. Ability to act as part of NICE Infrastructure Cloud Operations, continuously sharing information and assisting on tasks with other team members.
  9. Ability to provide excellent and ongoing support to other NICE business teams as needed to solve customer and product issues in a timely manner.
  10. Demonstrated ability to deal directly with internal and external customers in a friendly, supportive manner to troubleshoot and solve complex technical issues regarding NICE hosted performance, security, availability, and reliability
  11. Ability to work with or understanding of URL deployments and troubleshooting
  12. Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or other technical discipline or equivalent experience.
  13. PaloAlto Certification.
  14. AWS Certifications.

Additional Information:

This is a Hybrid model position in Bogotá Sutherland's Facilities at Torre Krystal (Cra 7 #156-10, Usaquén)

job.title: Devops Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 38 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

NICE is looking for a talented Cloud DevOps & Applications Operations Engineer interested in delivering the latest in Application Operations (SaaS) using AWS

At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're seeking highly skilled DevOps to build and operate end-to-end IaC in AWS for our product portfolio. The ideal candidate is comfortable across the entire stack — from responsive front-end interfaces and robust back-end services to databases, networking, and cloud deployment.

As a DevOps application engineer you will be responsible to design scalable APIs and data models, automate infrastructure and deployments, and collaborate closely with development, product support, and operations teams to deliver secure, reliable, high-performing software in the NiCE Cloud.

How will you make an impact?

  • Programing skills: Design and build responsive front-end interfaces and scalable back-end services and APIs, delivering features end to end.
  • Cloud Management: Leverage AWS services (EC2, IAM, RDS, S3, EBS, CloudWatch) to design and manage application infrastructure, ensuring high availability, security, and performance.
  • Infrastructure Automation: Implement and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, and containerized workloads using Kubernetes and Helm for scalable, reliable deployments.
  • Database Engineering: Design, deploy, and optimize relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, or Aurora (including AWS RDS); write and tune queries, manage backups, and resolve performance issues.
  • Scripting & Automation: Write and maintain Python (and PowerShell/Perl where relevant) scripts to automate build, deployment, and operational tasks, integrating tools and services.
  • Configuration Management: Use Ansible to automate configuration management, software deployment, and orchestration across environments.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Implement monitoring and logging (e.g. CloudWatch) to ensure the health of applications and infrastructure, and troubleshoot issues across the stack as they arise.
  • Networking & Security Awareness: Apply a working understanding of IP networking, TCP/IP, VPN, firewalls, and SSL to build and secure cloud-hosted applications.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with development, product support, and operations teams to ensure smooth deployment and operation of applications.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure that application code, infrastructure, and deployment processes comply with industry security standards and best practices.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of total experience, with 3+ years of hands-on DevOps & IaC  (and/or other major languages such as python, c# JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Perl).
  • Proven experience building full stack web applications — front-end frameworks plus back-end services and RESTful APIs.
  • In-depth knowledge of AWS services and best practices for cloud architecture and management.
  • Experience managing AWS infrastructure using Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration and container deployments using Helm.
  • Application deployment and configuration management using Ansible.
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, or Aurora) and AWS RDS, including backups, restores, and performance tuning.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix systems (RHEL, Amazon Linux); Windows server familiarity is a plus.
  • Working understanding of networking and security concepts (TCP/IP, VPN/IPSec, firewalls, SSL) for cloud-hosted, multi-tenant architectures.
  • Experience providing 24x7 support to production SaaS infrastructure, including on-call rotation and out-of-hours support when needed.
  • Understanding of ITIL processes — incidents, service requests, and change management.
  • B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech/M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) are a strong plus.
  • Proven ability to learn new technologies quickly and work effectively within a distributed, global team.
  • Detail-oriented and task-driven, with excellent communication skills and a strong customer-service focus.
  • Ability to work in a high-pressure, highly flexible environment against both short- and long-term objectives.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: Director - Research
job.description:
Company Description:

Account Management Lead – Research & Financial Markets

Sutherland’s Research & Financial Markets division drives high-impact transformation agenda to address our clients’ most complex business issues - from digital transformation and strategic cost management to operating model redesign, research enablement, analytics, automation, and managed service delivery.

Typical client segments include Investment Banks, Asset Management firms, Private Equity firms, Pension Funds, Sovereign Wealth Funds, Sell-side Research firms, large Corporates, and other Financial Markets institutions.

Sutherland Research has made significant investments in building differentiated solutions that help Financial Institutions reimagine how research, analytics, investment operations, portfolio monitoring, reporting, data management, and decision-support functions are delivered. Our solutions combine domain expertise, global delivery capability, AI-enabled workflows, and operating discipline to help clients improve efficiency, scalability, quality, and insight generation.

Our teams help clients architect future-state operating models, enhance service operations, expand research and analytics capacity, and maximize value from Sutherland’s engagement.

Job Description:

Reporting to the Business Head for Financial Markets, key responsibilities include:

► Manage and grow a portfolio of named Financial Markets accounts across Investment Banking, Asset Management, Private Equity, Pension Funds, and large Corporates
► Own account-level revenue targets, with responsibility for expansion, renewals, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities within specified accounts
► Develop deep client relationships across Research, Strategy, Investment Operations, Data, Analytics, Finance, and CXO-level stakeholders
► Identify new opportunities within existing accounts by understanding client priorities, operating challenges, budget cycles, and transformation agendas
► Generate new leads through disciplined outreach, referrals, client mapping, industry research, thought leadership follow-up, and relationship-led prospecting
► Build account plans for key clients, including stakeholder maps, current engagement footprint, whitespace opportunities, competitor presence, and growth strategy
► Position Sutherland’s high-end professional services across Investment Research, Portfolio Monitoring, Market Research, ESG Research, Investment Reporting, Automation, & Analytics
► Collaborate with Sales, Delivery, Solutioning, Research Leadership, and offshore subject matter experts to shape relevant client propositions
► Support proposal development, commercial discussions, pricing inputs, solution design, and contract renewal processes
► Deliver high-quality pitches and business reviews to senior stakeholders
► Maintain a disciplined account management cadence, including pipeline tracking, opportunity follow-up, CRM hygiene, revenue forecasting, and client touchpoint planning
► Ensure client satisfaction by proactively identifying service issues, escalation risks, delivery gaps, and opportunities to improve engagement quality
► Partner with delivery teams to ensure Sutherland is viewed as a strategic partner
► Support marketing and dissemination of thought leadership at various industry forums
► Travel as required for client meetings, account reviews, industry events, etc

Qualifications:

I. Candidate will possess strong account management and sales capabilities with a minimum of 6 - 10 years of progressive experience in account management, business development, enterprise sales, or client relationship management

II. Graduate degree required; Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline preferred

III. Should possess strong understanding of Financial Markets, including Investment Banking, Asset Management, Private Equity, Sell-side Research, Investment Operations, and Research & Analytics services

IV. Should have experience managing named accounts, developing account plans, identifying whitespace opportunities, and growing revenue within existing client relationships

V. Should be commercially astute, financially literate, and comfortable discussing research, analytics, data, reporting, and managed services with senior client stakeholders

job.title: AVP - CDE, Manufacturing
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is a digital transformation company focused on delivering exceptional experiences for both customers and employees. For 38 years, we have been entrusted with caring for our clients’ customers - a responsibility we believe we should earn every day. We are dedicated to making those experiences as delightful as possible - instantaneous, relevant, predictive, and frictionless. As an early pioneer in robotic automation, we added to our core through steady investment and acquiring key capabilities. Our design capabilities marry human insight, design- thinking, and process engineering. To make these designs come to life as envisioned by our designers, we employ the latest in robotic automation, conversational AI techniques with a range of AI-ML enhanced products and cloud-based platforms.

We believe that the best relationships come from trust and value. In addition to delivering exceptionally engineered experiences, we help our clients improve their productivity, reduce costs, enhance customer loyalty, build additional revenues, reduce time-to-market, and efficiently enter new markets. We also stand by our results. Sixty-one percent of our business is outcome based, ensuring our success is clearly tied to our clients’ success. We think that is simple for our clients to understand, and it adds to trust and transparency. Today, over 60 percent of our revenues come from clients with us for more than 11 years. Forty percent of our revenues come from Fortune-50, and 56 percent from Fortune-500 clients.

Though we have a rich history, our sights are anchored deeply in the future. We are optimistic about the benefits industry and society will see as human–machine collaboration continues to enhance what people can do. Our offerings deliver on this whether they are Sutherland Anywhere, enabling a secure remote work environment or Sutherland Connect, delivering data- rich, omni-channel services. Our deep product and platform expertise is trained on solving human problems before they emerge, and on how we wrap services around them - hiring, training, performance, security and more - to solve problems for our clients from end to end.  We work with clients across industries, including Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, Healthcare, Retail, Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment, and Technology, as well as Travel, Hospitality and Logistics.

Our digital backbone spans 144 countries around the world, with 61 delivery centers across 19 countries, handling over 43 million transactions a month for approximately 70 clients. We are a team of 38,000 global professionals, operationally effective, culturally meshed, and committed to our clients and to one another. We call it One Sutherland.

Job Description:

The Senior Team Leader is responsible for leading multiple Content Protection Operations (CPro) teams, ensuring the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of copyright infringement and legal claims. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to consistently achieve Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Quality, Critical Fail (CF), Quality Defect (QD), Average Handling Time (AHT), productivity, turnaround time (TAT), and legal compliance targets. The Senior Team Leader drives operational excellence through effective workforce planning, operational governance, risk management, continuous improvement, and people development while partnering closely with Legal, Content Operations, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, HR, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure business continuity and operational success.

Key Responsibilities:

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop Team Leaders to consistently achieve operational, quality, compliance, and people performance objectives.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  • Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, talent assessments, and succession planning activities.

  • Drive employee engagement, retention, leadership capability development, and recognition initiatives.

  • Build a high-performing leadership team capable of delivering consistent business results.

 

Operations Management

  • Oversee the day-to-day delivery of multiple Content Protection Operations workstreams, ensuring the efficient, accurate, and compliant processing of copyright infringement and legal claims.

  • Ensure achievement of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Average Handling Time (AHT), Quality, Critical Fail (CF), Quality Defect (QD), productivity, turnaround time (TAT), backlog, and operational performance targets.

  • Monitor operational health through performance dashboards and proactively mitigate operational risks impacting business performance.

  • Establish and maintain operational governance by ensuring adherence to client policies, standard operating procedures, and regulatory requirements.

  • Lead operational readiness for new initiatives, policy changes, and business requirements.

 

Legal Compliance, Quality & Risk Management

  • Ensure all infringement claims are processed in accordance with applicable copyright laws, legal requirements, Spotify policies, and operational procedures.

  • Partner with Legal, Quality, and Content Operations teams to maintain high decision accuracy and operational compliance.

  • Drive initiatives to minimize Critical Fail (CF) and Quality Defects (QD) through proactive coaching, calibration sessions, quality governance, and root cause analysis.

  • Lead corrective and preventive action plans resulting from quality reviews, compliance audits, operational risks, and recurring defects.

  • Maintain audit readiness and promote a culture of compliance, operational discipline, and continuous quality improvement.

 

Workforce Management & Capacity Planning

  • Partner with Workforce Management (WFM) to develop short- and long-term staffing strategies aligned with forecasted demand, business priorities, and operational targets.

  • Analyze workload trends, case volumes, productivity, backlog, shrinkage, and staffing models to forecast capacity requirements and mitigate operational risks.

  • Optimize workforce utilization through effective resource allocation, schedule optimization, cross-training, and workload balancing while consistently achieving SLA, AHT, Quality, Compliance, and productivity objectives.

  • Develop contingency and business continuity plans to effectively manage volume fluctuations, operational disruptions, and evolving business requirements.

  • Utilize workforce analytics to support hiring plans, organizational design, budget forecasting, and long-term workforce strategy.

 

Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze operational and business performance metrics to identify trends, risks, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Lead cross-functional Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions to improve Quality, Critical Fail (CF), Quality Defects (QD), AHT, productivity, compliance, and operational efficiency.

  • Drive process standardization, documentation improvements, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to improve scalability, decision accuracy, and operational effectiveness.

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance while reducing operational risk and manual effort.

  • Support implementation of new tools, technologies, workflows, and operational initiatives.

 

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with Legal, Content Operations, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, HR, and other internal stakeholders.

  • Present operational performance, quality trends, compliance metrics, workforce insights, risks, and strategic recommendations during business reviews and leadership meetings.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex operational, workforce, compliance, and quality-related issues requiring executive oversight.

  • Influence strategic decisions through data-driven insights, operational expertise, and collaborative problem-solving.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Legal Management, Law, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum of five (5) years [external applicant] or 12 months [internal applicant] of progressive experience in Content Protection Operations, Copyright Enforcement, Trust & Safety, Legal Operations, Digital Rights Management (DRM), Intellectual Property, or a related domain.

  • Extensive hands-on experience managing end-to-end copyright infringement and legal claims, including complex, high-risk, and escalated cases involving global digital content platforms.

  • Minimum of three (3) years of leadership experience managing Team Leaders or multiple operational teams within a BPO, shared services, or global operations environment.

  • Demonstrated expertise in copyright regulations, digital rights management, content protection policies, legal compliance, and operational governance.

  • Proven success delivering results across SLA, Quality, Critical Fail (CF), Quality Defects (QD), AHT, Productivity, Compliance, Backlog Management, and Workforce Efficiency metrics.

  • Strong analytical and strategic planning skills with experience in workforce planning, capacity management, root cause analysis, risk management, and operational governance.

  • Experience leading operational transformation, continuous improvement, automation, and AI adoption initiatives.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, executive presentation, coaching, and leadership development skills.

Applicants who has experience managing You Tube, Google, Content Moderation is good to have.

job.title: VP CDE - TTHL
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is a digital transformation company focused on delivering exceptional experiences for both customers and employees. For 38 years, we have been entrusted with caring for our clients’ customers - a responsibility we believe we should earn every day. We are dedicated to making those experiences as delightful as possible - instantaneous, relevant, predictive, and frictionless. As an early pioneer in robotic automation, we added to our core through steady investment and acquiring key capabilities. Our design capabilities marry human insight, design- thinking, and process engineering. To make these designs come to life as envisioned by our designers, we employ the latest in robotic automation, conversational AI techniques with a range of AI-ML enhanced products and cloud-based platforms.

We believe that the best relationships come from trust and value. In addition to delivering exceptionally engineered experiences, we help our clients improve their productivity, reduce costs, enhance customer loyalty, build additional revenues, reduce time-to-market, and efficiently enter new markets. We also stand by our results. Sixty-one percent of our business is outcome based, ensuring our success is clearly tied to our clients’ success. We think that is simple for our clients to understand, and it adds to trust and transparency. Today, over 60 percent of our revenues come from clients with us for more than 11 years. Forty percent of our revenues come from Fortune-50, and 56 percent from Fortune-500 clients.

Though we have a rich history, our sights are anchored deeply in the future. We are optimistic about the benefits industry and society will see as human–machine collaboration continues to enhance what people can do. Our offerings deliver on this whether they are Sutherland Anywhere, enabling a secure remote work environment or Sutherland Connect, delivering data- rich, omni-channel services. Our deep product and platform expertise is trained on solving human problems before they emerge, and on how we wrap services around them - hiring, training, performance, security and more - to solve problems for our clients from end to end.  We work with clients across industries, including Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, Healthcare, Retail, Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment, and Technology, as well as Travel, Hospitality and Logistics.

Our digital backbone spans 144 countries around the world, with 61 delivery centers across 19 countries, handling over 43 million transactions a month for approximately 70 clients. We are a team of 38,000 global professionals, operationally effective, culturally meshed, and committed to our clients and to one another. We call it One Sutherland.

Sutherland Healthcare Solutions is a leading provider of Health Information Management, Revenue Cycle Management and Healthcare Customer support solutions to the healthcare industry. Our solutions encompass a comprehensive suite of platform enabled back-office and front office services that span the Provider, Payer, and Healthcare IT sub verticals.


We collaborate with healthcare providers and payers utilizing a unique and flexible blended shore approach. Our solutions are focused on increasing the operating margins and cash flow generation of our healthcare clients by deploying efficient business processes, proprietary re-engineering methodologies and technology enabled automation.

Job Description:

ROLE SUMMARY: 

The CDE is responsible for selling Sutherland offerings, Managed Services/BPaaS to new logo accounts where Sutherland presently has no relationships.  The CDE drives new logo revenues through relationship development, quality delivery and execution of all engagement that drive organic growth and strong relationship.

An ideal CDE is passionate about developing and driving new client relationships and can successfully interact with senior executive level clients. This individual manages new revenue development and can lead complex multi-dimensional engagements that combine digital, consulting, and large technology deployments. This person is a high-energy leader with the ability to grow client relationships through presenting new strategies and innovative ideas. 

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:   

  • Direct business development and sales activities with new relationships within a set of base accounts
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of 5X of in year revenue target.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities which equate to a $3M ACV total and/or $1M ACV digital deal profile.
  • Deliver assigned in year revenue target ranging from $4-10+M; while meeting company EBITDA targets.
  • Establish and maintain consultative sales relationships within each prospective client organization and constantly look to meet new buyers within our clients’ organization
  • Identify opportunities to offer value through our new strategic services
  • Thoroughly understand the client’s business, both strategic and tactical, including themes and underlying issues, and align Sutherland’s current and future capabilities to create client opportunities and solve business problems
  • Sell across the suite of services, including digital transformation, IT, customer engagement, and business process transformation services
  • Leverage TTHL domain expertise, technical, digital and operational knowledge to create demand and persuade prospective clients through the development and presentation of compelling value propositions and purchasing rationales
  • Accountable for the client relationship from deal conception to closing
  • Use financial acumen to position a value proposition for the client, as well as financial soundness for the organization, making the client confident in their choice to grow with Sutherland

Qualifications:

  • Education: bachelor’s degree, MBA/ Masters
  • 10+ years of experience in new logo business development for $3-5M ACV entry point accounts; proven track record of achieving multimillion-dollar sales target
  • Deep and broad TTHL domain expertise and industry experience
  • Proven track record of building relationships of trust with new clients at the highest levels in an organization, as well as expanding beyond the initial client to grow the company’s footprint and secure winning client references
  • Can craft a story around digital transformation, IT, customer engagement and business process transformation services in the context of the client’s business strategy.  Must be able to develop a transformative roadmap for the client that addresses their complex problems and needs
  • Experience assessing large complex global organizations, identifying, prioritizing and pursuing large TAM fields of play with transformative digitally enabled domain-led, outcome-based business process and/or business process as a service (BPAAS) solutions
  • Experience selling across multiple towers of an organization; including CEO, COO, CIO, CDO, CMO, CFO organizations
  • Business Process and/or IT Services sector expertise with applied experience selling solutions centered around customer experience, finance & accounting, AI/ML solutions and IT services
  • Industry sector expertise with a deep understanding of core business functions and technologies; and the ability to assess a current state versus a future state business architecture; while building a value proposition and business case to transform and deliver client business outcomes
  • Commercial experience, acumen and creativity in helping clients shift from per unit cost pricing models to outcome-based transactional and TCO based models
  • Experience in building and executing an individual sales plan; which includes revenue forecasting, strategic account planning with action plan
  • Experience leveraging strategic selling and account planning tools, such as Korn Ferry Blue and Gold Sheets
  • Knowledge and understanding of the analyst and advisor community.
  • An orchestrator who inspires, coordinates and leads global, matrixed deal structuring teams in multiple deal types, including TCO, multi-tower, digital, consulting, managed services, etc.
  • Confident communication/ active listener with top tier skills in “telling the story” and facilitating conversation

Network Engineering & Architecture

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, and cloud networking solutions.

  • Develop and maintain network architecture standards, diagrams, and technical documentation.

  • Evaluate and recommend network technologies, hardware, and software solutions.

  • Lead network upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives.

 

Operations & Support

  • Provide Tier 2/3 support for complex network incidents and outages.

  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring issues.

  • Ensure network availability, performance, and reliability through proactive monitoring and maintenance.

  • Participate in on-call support and incident response activities as required.

 

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and maintain network security controls, including firewalls, VPNs, NAC, segmentation, and secure remote access.

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.

  • Support compliance, audit, and risk management requirements.

Cloud & Infrastructure Integration

  • Design and support connectivity to Azure, AWS, GCP and OCI.

  • Integrate network services with enterprise infrastructure platforms.

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

  • Experience supporting large-scale and mission-critical environments.

  • Experience with Cloud networking.

  • Experience with SD-WAN and network automation technologies.

  • Knowledge of scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Terraform, or Ansible.

  • Industry certifications such as CCIE, CISSP, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or AWS Advanced Networking Specialty.

 

Technical Skills

 

  • BGP, MPLS, and routing protocols

  • Layer 2/Layer 3 switching technologies

  • Wireless networking and controller-based architectures

  • VPN, Firewall, IDS/IPS, and Zero Trust technologies

  • SD-WAN and Internet connectivity solutions

  • Cloud native and hybrid-cloud networking

  • Network monitoring and performance management tools

  • Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies

 

Key Competencies

  • Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • Strong business acumen and orientation.
  • Revenue forecast management.
  • Budget management.
  • PMP Certification desirable
  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in systems engineering and related fields.
  • Proficient communication skills in English.

Job Description:

The Facility-Fee Emergency Department Medical Coder is responsible for the accurate review, abstraction, and assignment of ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, facility-specific charging methodologies, and applicable modifiers for Emergency Department (ED) facility encounters. This role ensures coding accuracy, regulatory compliance, appropriate reimbursement, and adherence to client-specific coding guidelines, payer requirements, and industry standards.

The coder will review clinical documentation, emergency department records, physician documentation, nursing notes, ancillary reports, and charging information to accurately capture facility services rendered during emergency department visits. The position requires strong knowledge of facility fee coding, emergency department leveling methodologies, and outpatient reimbursement regulations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Review emergency department medical records to assign accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes, CPT/HCPCS procedure codes, and applicable modifiers.
  • Accurately assign facility Evaluation and Management (E/M) levels in accordance with client-specific emergency department leveling guidelines and facility charging methodologies, including knowledge of the ACEP tool.
  • Analyze documentation from nursing staff, physicians, ancillary departments, and diagnostic services to ensure complete code assignment and charge capture.
  • Apply official coding guidelines, CMS regulations, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, and payer-specific requirements.
  • Review accounts for appropriate assignment of procedural services and injections/infusions when applicable.
  • Identify documentation deficiencies and communicate within the appropriate channels regarding coding clarification needs.
  • Maintain compliance with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, and organizational coding policies.
  • Participate in coding quality reviews, audits, educational initiatives, and process improvement activities.
  • Remain current on coding updates, reimbursement changes, and regulatory requirements affecting emergency department facility coding.
  • Collaborate with coding leadership, auditors, and client representatives to resolve coding-related issues.

Qualifications:

To qualify you must possess:

  • At least 2+ years of relevant facility-fee outpatient coding experience, specifically in Emergency Department services. Injection and Infusion experience required.
  • Active AAPC or AHIMA coding certification required.
  • Proven ability to work independently and efficiently in a remote environment
  • Epic experience strongly preferred.
  • Other facility-fee and physician-fee medical coding experience a plus

job.title: Technical Account Manager
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 39 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking a Technical Account Manager to play a key role in driving customer success, service excellence, and technical relationship management across enterprise customer environments. This role requires a strong combination of technical expertise, customer-facing experience, operational excellence, and stakeholder management skills. The ideal candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to customers while partnering closely with Engineering, Support, Product, and cross-functional teams to ensure successful service delivery and customer outcomes.

The Technical Account Manager performs a wide range of duties including some or all the following:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for designated customer accounts, ensuring alignment between customer priorities and business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders and technical teams while maintaining effective communication across multiple organizational levels.
  • Monitor support activities, service trends, operational metrics, and customer health indicators to proactively identify risks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for designated accounts, coordinating resolution efforts and driving critical issues to closure.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between Support, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and other internal teams to resolve technical challenges and improve customer experience.
  • Drive customer communication during escalations, incidents, operational issues, and service-impacting events.
  • Identify barriers to product adoption, customer success, or operational efficiency and partner with internal teams to implement improvements.
  • Support transition activities from implementation to production support, ensuring operational readiness and successful customer onboarding.
  • Develop and maintain account-specific operational processes, best practices, and service management activities aligned with organizational standards.
  • Lead customer reviews, operational discussions, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to technical teams while supporting knowledge sharing and operational maturity.
  • Communicate customer feedback, requirements, risks, and opportunities to internal stakeholders including Product Management, Engineering, and Leadership teams.
  • Support global operations including occasional travel, on-call responsibilities, or work outside standard business hours when required.

Qualifications:

  • Advanced English proficiency (B2 or Higher)

Level 1: 1 year to 2 years
Level 2: 2 years to 4 years
Level 3: 4 years to 7 years

Location: Chennai, India (Mandatory Work from Office)
Shift: US Night Shift (5 Days a Week)

Role #1

US Payroll - Level 2 & Level 3

We are seeking an experienced Senior Payroll Specialist / Lead to serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for US payroll operations. This role is responsible for ensuring compliant, accurate, and efficient payroll delivery while driving continuous improvement initiatives. The position offers exposure to complex multi-state payroll, global governance, advanced system operations, and leadership opportunities.

The Lead will additionally review and validate pre-payroll inputs, analyze payroll outputs, administer post-payroll activities, mentor junior specialists, and ensure adherence to SLAs/KPIs. This role requires night shift support with rotational weekly offs and is based out of our Chennai office.

 

Role #2

Payroll Tax Analyst – Level 3

We are looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Tax Analyst with strong experience in US Payroll Tax and multi-state payroll operations.

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage end-to-end payroll tax processing & reconciliations

• Prepare/review Federal, State & Local tax filings (941, 940, W-2, W-2C)

• Handle tax notices, amendments & compliance deadlines

• Support year-end payroll tax activities

• Drive process improvements & stakeholder coordination

 

What We’re Looking For:

• 4+ years of Payroll / Payroll Tax experience

• Strong knowledge of US payroll tax regulations

• Experience in multi-state payroll environment

• Hands-on with ADP, Workday or similar payroll tools

• Strong Excel & analytical skills

 

Role #3

Benefits Administration - Level 1

We are looking for a highly detail-oriented and dependable Compensation Specialist to join our HR Shared Services team in Chennai. This role plays a critical part in ensuring accurate and compliant administration of compensation and benefits processes for the US region. The specialist will work extensively with Workday Compensation modules, support annual compensation cycles, maintain data accuracy, and deliver exceptional employee experience through timely and precise operations.

This is a work-from-office, night-shift role with rotational weekly offs.

Benefits Administration - Level 2

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Senior Compensation Specialist to support and enhance US compensation and benefits operations. This role serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for compensation processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution of compensation programs. The Senior Associate will focus on executing compensation cycles and managing complex data validations.

The ideal candidate possesses deep knowledge of US compensation regulations, hands-on experience with Workday Compensation, strong analytical capability, and a commitment to operational excellence. This role requires working night shifts with rotational weekly offs and is based out of our Chennai office.

 

Role #4

Compliance & Incident Management – Hotline Support

Level 1

The L1 Hotline Support role is responsible for being the first point of contact for compliance and incident-related queries received via hotline, email, or ticketing tools. The individual will take calls, capture accurate information, create incidents, and route requests as per defined SOPs.

Level 2

The L2 Hotline Support role handles complex hotline interactions, performs advanced triage, validates incident details, and ensures correct categorization, prioritization, and resolution routing. The role also supports quality checks, coaching of L1 resources, and escalation management.

Level 3

We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented, and compliance-focused Lead – Compliance & Incident Management (L3) to support US HR Shared Services operations. This role serves as a subject matter expert (SME) for US HR compliance, incident governance, documentation integrity, and audit readiness. The Lead is responsible for resolving complex cases, supporting investigations, guiding team members, and ensuring adherence to federal and state regulations.

 

Talent Management - Level 2 & Level 3

  • We are seeking an experienced Senior Talent Management Specialist / Lead to serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for US Talent programs, supporting end-to-end execution of Talent cycles, Workday configuration, and operational governance. This role ensures seamless execution of performance management, succession planning, talent data integrity, and recruitment support processes.
  • The Lead will additionally oversee candidate screening and background verification (BGV) workflows, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and professional handling of sensitive information. This role also requires mentoring junior specialists, managing escalations, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across Talent Operations. This position supports US time zones, requires night shift work with rotational weekly offs, and is based in our Chennai office.

Role #4

HR Administration

Level 1

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and motivated HR Operations Specialist to join our high-performing HR Shared Services (HRSS) team supporting the US region. This role is essential in ensuring accurate execution of core HR processes, maintaining compliance, and delivering a seamless employee experience.

The ideal candidate brings strong operational discipline, foundational knowledge of US HR practices, and the ability to support recruitment operations while collaborating effectively across teams.

Level 2

This role requires deep subject matter expertise in HR processes, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to ensure compliance with US labor laws and regulatory standards.

job.title: Cloud Support Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 39 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking a Cloud Support Engineer to play a key role in supporting, monitoring, and maintaining enterprise cloud-based applications and production environments. This role requires a strong technical background in application support, cloud operations, troubleshooting, and production environment management. The ideal candidate will work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Customer Support, and cross-functional teams to ensure the stability, availability, and performance of mission-critical systems.

The Cloud Support Engineer performs a wide range of duties including some or all the following:

  • Monitor, maintain, and support cloud-hosted applications and production environments to ensure high availability and optimal performance.
  • Perform operational activities including application health monitoring, service management, server maintenance, and environment support.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve operational issues related to applications, infrastructure, data pipelines, integrations, batch processing, and network connectivity.
  • Monitor server performance metrics including CPU utilization, memory consumption, databases, file systems, application services, and scheduled jobs.
  • Review, prioritize, and resolve production incidents and support requests while maintaining service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for application, infrastructure, database, and operational issues.
  • Maintain operational documentation including runbooks, troubleshooting guides, incident records, and support procedures.
  • Generate operational reports, production metrics, status updates, and environment health dashboards.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Infrastructure teams to optimize application reliability, scalability, and deployment processes.
  • Support on-call rotations and provide off-hours support when required to maintain production availability.

Qualifications:

  • Advanced English proficiency (B2 or Higher)
  • 2+ years of experience supporting production environments, cloud operations, application support, infrastructure support, or related technical roles.
  • Experience supporting cloud-hosted environments and familiarity with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Hands-on experience working with Unix/Linux environments, Windows servers, shell scripting, SSH, and application server management.
  • Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or similar technologies.
  • Understanding of application monitoring, troubleshooting, debugging, performance optimization, and scalability concepts.
  • Familiarity with data flows, ETL processes, integrations, and distributed application environments.
  • Knowledge of application security best practices, fault detection, incident management, and operational processes.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues quickly.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with customers, technical teams, and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in fast-paced production environments.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and support non-prime shift operations when required.

Additional Information:

Hybrid work model: 3 days working from home and 2 days onsite at our Torre Krystal offices in Bogotá.

job.title: Technical Support Engineer – Payments
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 39 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Overview

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Technical Customer Support Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in payments, transaction processing, and customer service, with a passion for payments. In this role, you will be the key point of contact for both internal teams and clients internal teams and clients, providing timely, effective solutions to technical issues, driving customer satisfaction, and contributing to process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Customer/Client Centricity

  • Be a named point of contact and take ownership of service for a group of Thredd clients, ensuring their needs are met with high standards of service.
  • Provide second-level analysis, investigation, and resolution for customer service requests related to card/transaction processing, electronic Point of Sale (POS), ATMs, and fraud.
  • Advocate for clients, representing their requirements and needs within the organization to ensure alignment on new features or enhancements.
  • Work closely with internal teams (Customer Care, Tech, and Product) and third parties to address root causes of issues and prevent future occurrences.
  • Ensure clear, timely communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, adapting your approach based on the audience.

Problem-Solving & Incident Management

  • Resolve technical issues related to transaction processing, including fraud, chargebacks, 3DS, and other payment systems.
  • Follow and adhere to incident management procedures, ensuring appropriate escalation, investigation, and communication.

Data & Reporting

  • Provide analysis on card/transaction data, leveraging in-house systems (e.g., SC, EHI, WS, Jira) and external tools (e.g., Postman, ELK, Soap).
  • Develop and present data-driven insights that inform decision-making, product improvements, and customer service enhancements.

Leadership & Team Collaboration

  • Build strong relationships across departments (e.g., IMPS, AM, AS, Product) to foster teamwork and ensure alignment on goals.
  • Support team learning and development, sharing knowledge and best practices.
  • Manage personal performance and goals to drive continuous improvement and ensure successful project outcomes.

Qualifications:

Required Experience:

  • Advanced English proficiency (B2 or Higher)
  • A proven track record of successful technical customer support or client-facing roles, especially in payments, transaction processing, or banking.
  • Deep understanding of transaction systems (card, POS, ATM), fraud prevention (3DS), chargebacks, and payment gateways.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment where client service and quick resolution of issues are critical.
  • Strong technical knowledge of APIs (Soap or REST), SQL, XML/JSON, and familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Postman, ELK, etc.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with an ability to make sound decisions based on good judgement.
  • Experience in data analysis and reporting using tools like Excel or similar.

Desirable Experience:

  • Familiarity with MasterCard/Visa processing, platform functionality, and the impact of regulatory and scheme changes.
  • Exposure to fraud systems, 3DS, and other payment security tools.
  • Experience working in B2B and/or operational support roles, specifically within payments or technology sectors.

Core Skills:

  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills in English, with the ability to adapt language for diverse audiences.
  • Ability to perform effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to problem-solving.
  • Time management skills with a strong sense of urgency and the ability to prioritise workloads effectively.
